lecons.title: The types of meals and meal planning
lecons.summary: A meal is the type of food we eat at a particular time. There are three types: breakfast in the morning, lunch in the afternoon, which is usually heavy, and supper or dinner in the evening. Meal planning is preparing to serve food and feed the family on time, daily, weekly or monthly.
